title: Author the game build-type template
description: Create templates/game/template.json and templates/game/files/: package.json (name {{slug}}, test script), README.md, .gitignore, src/game.js with a pure step(state, input) reducer and an initialState, src/index.js wiring the reducer to a stdin loop, test/game.test.js exercising the pure reducer. Only {{slug}}/{{summary}} placeholders; only node: built-ins. A test renders the template and asserts required_files + valid report.
acceptance_criteria: templates/game/template.json validates against template.schema.json and lists its required_files.
Scaffolding build_type=game renders the files/ tree with placeholders substituted and writes a valid scaffold-report.json.
The pure reducer test passes under node --test (no TTY needed); full suite passes.
